zoe: Heads-up: new onboard for `pegasus-rerank` shows ndcg@10 down ~2.2% on curated_holdout but mrr@10 up ~0.9%. PR changed passage trimming (256->208) + enabled url/emoji joiner. Anyone seen this pattern?
carlos: Can you paste the eval command you ran?
zoe: `./tools/rankbench --model pegasus-rerank --set curated_holdout --metrics ndcg@10,mrr@10,p@1 --seed 99`
megan: Quick cohort split: short-query head ndcg +0.6% mrr +1.1%. long-doc tail ndcg -4.0% mrr -0.3% — sounds like context loss.
zoe: I queued an ablation: snippet=256/232/208, normalizer=old/new, tokenizer=before/after. eval-bot should run matrix.
eval-bot: ablation queued (run id rb-4141). ETA ~20m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
carlos: While waiting, can someone dump top-10 churn for 30 regressed queries? Helps pinpoint whether mid-tail is moving.
megan: Uploaded churn CSV: most shifts at positions 4-9, many docs had trailing bullets/code that got trimmed.
eval-bot: results:
``n
snippet=256 normalizer=old tokenizer=before -> ndcg@10 0.4302 mrr@10 0.2190
snippet=232 normalizer=old tokenizer=before -> ndcg@10 0.4267 mrr@10 0.2204
snippet=208 normalizer=old tokenizer=before -> ndcg@10 0.4221 mrr@10 0.2212
snippet=256 normalizer=new tokenizer=before -> ndcg@10 0.4285 mrr@10 0.2201
snippet=232 normalizer=new tokenizer=before -> ndcg@10 0.4240 mrr@10 0.2218
snippet=208 normalizer=new tokenizer=before -> ndcg@10 0.4192 mrr@10 0.2229
snippet=208 normalizer=new tokenizer=after  -> ndcg@10 0.4168 mrr@10 0.2241
```
zoe: Clear pattern: both shorter snippets and new normalizer reduce ndcg; tokenizer-after mapping amplifies the worst case.
carlos: Proposed plan: 1) try snippet=232 as compromise and run targeted long-doc slice; 2) revert tokenizer-after doc mapping but keep normalizer; 3) block canary until holdout_longdoc ndcg is within tolerance.
megan: I'll start the 232 long-doc run and generate per-query delta CSV.
eval-bot: hold flag set for pegasus-rerank (reason: ndcg regression on holdout_longdoc >1%).
